fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.body:
Living room — TV with French terrestrial channels.

Bedroom — Samsung Smart TV with Netflix, Molotov and myCanal (use your own credentials). AirPlay (iPhone) and Chromecast (Android) available.
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.title: Coffee
fields.amenities.3.body:
Hob and dishwasher (Ikea brand) — tablets provided.

No dish rack: use the dishwasher for drying.
fields.amenities.3.title: Kitchen
fields.amenities.4.sub: Whirlpool · the dryer stops automatically after ~1h30
fields.amenities.4.title: Washer-dryer
fields.amenities.5.body:
Central heating shared by the building. Portable heaters are available for shoulder seasons.

Summer — portable air conditioner and fans available; lower the roller shutters during hot hours.
fields.amenities.5.title: Heating & air conditioning
fields.amenities.6.body: The living room sofa unfolds into an extra bed.
fields.amenities.6.title: Sofa bed
fields.amenities.7.body: Travel crib and high chair available. The travel crib is in the storage box at the foot of the street-side bed (or sometimes behind the sofa).
fields.amenities.7.title: Baby equipment
fields.amenities.8.body:
To get started — Nespresso capsules and tea (first night), 2 rolls of toilet paper, dishwasher tablets.

Shower gel, shampoo, hair dryer and iron provided. Tap water is safe to drink.
fields.amenities.8.title: What we provide
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.0: Make sure you're entering the code on the box labeled « L. Bellevue » — it's fixed to the wall to the left of the apartment door, on the 1st floor.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.1: Enter the digits one by one, without pressing too hard, then open the panel.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: If it's stuck, realign the dials with the code and try again calmly. If it won't budge, get in touch with us.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.title: Having trouble opening the keybox?

fields.house_rules.0.title: Non-smoking apartment
fields.house_rules.1.text: A decibel detector (linked to an alarm) and a camera on the landing monitor noise levels. No conversations are recorded.
fields.house_rules.1.title: No parties or gatherings
fields.house_rules.2.text: Please respect your neighbors — avoid noise and frequent comings and goings.
fields.house_rules.2.title: Quiet after 10 pm
fields.house_rules.3.text: To protect guests with allergies who come after you.
fields.house_rules.3.title: No pets
fields.house_rules.4.text: Please don't unplug or move it: it triggers an alarm if tampered with.
fields.house_rules.4.title: CO₂ sensor
fields.house_rules.5.text: Only people listed on the booking are allowed. To add guests, update your reservation.
fields.house_rules.5.title: Registered guests
fields.luggage.sub_arrival: Nannybag luggage storage in Besançon · from €4.90/day
fields.luggage.sub_departure: Drop off your luggage and enjoy Besançon until your train · from €4.90/day
fields.parking.photos.0.title: « Battant » parking
fields.parking.summary: Street parking + free parking 200 m away
fields.parking.text.0: Drop-off zone: unload in front of the building along avenue Foch, then park your car.
fields.parking.text.1: Free « Battant » parking: 200 m away, over 1,000 spaces. Turn right at the roundabout in front of the residence.
fields.parking.text.2: Paid street parking: parking in front of the building is paid and often monitored — free on Sundays.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: Comté cheese specialties — cancoillotte, fondue, tartiflette. 400 m away, rue Battant. Choose your wine from the wine shop.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: Sushi with a view of the park, right next to the apartment.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Large friendly pizzeria, across from the station.
fields.recos.food.3.desc: Contemporary bistro, seasonal produce and vegetarian options. 600 m away. Tel. 03 81 50 10 20.
fields.recos.food.4.desc: Stunning Art Deco setting from 1850, refined cuisine at reasonable prices. Reservation recommended.
fields.recos.food.5.desc: Burgundy-Franche-Comté regional cuisine in a historic building, lovely terrace.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: Local grocery store, rue de Belfort.
fields.recos.shop.2.desc: Newspapers, tobacco and essentials, near the station.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Vauban masterpiece, UNESCO-listed: ramparts, city views, zoo, aquarium and museums.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: In Palais Granvelle, traces Besançon's watchmaking history.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: 19th-century masterpiece in St-Jean cathedral (under restoration until 2030).
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: Victor Hugo's birthplace, at 140 Grande Rue. Contemporary scenography and multimedia, moving visit.
fields.transport.lines.0.text: Right across the street, 150 m away. A shuttle takes you to the TGV station in about ten minutes.
fields.transport.lines.0.title: Viotte station
fields.transport.lines.1.text: Trams T1 and T2 and Ginko buses 100 m away in front of the station. Pay by card on board, no ticket needed.
fields.transport.lines.1.title: Tram & bus
fields.transport.lines.2.text: Uber doesn't serve Besançon. Radio Taxis at 03 81 88 80 80 for the TGV station or La Vèze airfield.
fields.transport.lines.2.title: Taxi
fields.transport.lines.3.text: Vélocité bike-sharing for short trips, or daily rentals at local shops.
fields.transport.lines.3.title: Bike
fields.transport.summary: Across from Viotte station · trams & buses 100 m away
